chapter.verse: “Tua ciangin Sardis khua-a pawlpi' vanmi' tungah hih bangin lai gelh in: ‘Hih pen Pasian' khate sagih leh aksi sagih a nei mipa' thugen ahi hi. “‘Na gamtatnate ka thei hi. Nungta cih min na pua a, a taktakin a si na hi hi.
Pilvang navak inla, a omlai a si dektak teng thapia in. A hang pen na gamtatnate ka Pasian' mai-ah a cingtaak ka mu naikei hi.
Tua ahih manin na ngah thu leh na zak thu phawkkik in. Tua thu zui inla kisik in. Na pilvang keileh guta bangin kong tun ding hunlenai na thei kei ding hi.
Ahi zongin Sardis pawlpi ah a puantual uh a thanghuaisak lo mimal tawmno khat na nei lai sam hi. Amaute kilawm kituak uh ahih manin puantual paak silhin kei tawh hong tonkhawm ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, a gualzo mi puantual paak kisilhsak ding a, nuntakna laibu sungpan a min ka phiatkhia ngeikei ding hi. Ka Pa' mai leh ama' vanmite' mai-ah ama' min ka pulak ding hi.
Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen.’

“Tua ciangin Philadelphia khua-a pawlpi' vanmi' tungah hih bangin lai gelh in: ‘Hih pen David' tawhtang a nei, kuamah' khakkik zawhloh dingin a hongkhia, kuamah' honkik zawhloh dingin a khakcip, Siangthopa, Ahi Taktakpa' thugen ahi hi.’
“ ‘Na sepkhiatte ka thei hi. En in, kuamah' khak zawhloh kongpi kihong khat na mai-ah kong koih hi. Na thahatna neuno khat bek ahih hangin ka thu nong zui a, ka min nong nial kei hi.

En in, Jew mi hilo pipi ka hi uh ci-in zuau a phuak Satan' kipawlpihte' tungah ka tuahsak ding thu—en in, na khe-phung ah hong pai-in hong kunsuk nadingun ka bawl ding hi. Tua ciangin tua mite in nang kong it lam theitel ding uh hi.
Lungduai thuakzawh ding kong thuhilhna hong zui na hih manin leitunga teeng mite a zia-et ding, leitung bup-a hong tung ding ahi zia-etna hunlenai, tua sungpan nang kong kem ding hi.
Kei kong pai baih ding hi. Na kumpi-lukhu kuamah in hong suhkhiat loh nadingin tu-a na neih pen lenkip in.

A gualzo mi, ka Pasian' biakinnpi sungah khuampi khat ka hisak ding hi. Tua mun pan amah paikhia ngeilo ding a, ama' tungah ka Pasian' min ahi zongin, Jerusalem thak a kici vantung ka Pasian' kiangpana hong paisuk ka Pasian' khuapi min ahi zongin, keimahmah ii min thak ahi zongin, ka gelh ding hi.
Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen.’
“Laodicea khua-a om pawlpi ii vanmi' kiangah hih bangin lai gelh in: ‘A ciamkip leh teci maan, Pasian' piansakna a bulpi ahi Amen' thugen ahi hi.
“‘Na sepkhiatte ka thei hi: Na vot kei a, lah na sa kei hi. Na votleh vot, na satleh sat ding kong deih hi.
Tua hi a, sa lah sa lo, vot lah vot lo, laklawh na hih manin ka kam pan kong siakhia kuan hi.
A hang pen a gim a tawl, a khasiat-huai, a zawng, khuamulo leh guaktanga om na hihlam na kitel kei a, ka hau hi, ka cithei hi, bangmah ka kisam kei hi, na ci hi.

Na hauh theih nadingin mei tawh a kihalsan kham ahi zongin, maizumhuai guaktang-a na omna a kilat loh nadingin na silh ding puantual paak ahi zongin, khua na muh theih nadingin na mit na nuh ding mitza ahi zongin, hihte kei' kiangpan nong lei ding kong deihsak hi.
Ka it mite taai-in ka hilh ka sek hi. Tua ahih manin nakpi-in kinbawl inla kisik in.
En in, kongbiang ah dingin kong ka kiu hi. Mi khatpeuh in ka aw za-in kong hong honleh ama' kiangah lutin amah tawh ankuang ka uumkhawm ding a, amah zong kei tawh ankuang hong uumkhawm ding hi.
Kei gualzo-in ka Pa tawh ama' kumpi-tokhom tungah ka tutkhop mah bangin a gualzo mi zong keima' kumpi-tokhom tungah kei tawh tutkhop theihna thu ka pia ding hi.
Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen.’”
